name: Maze
description: Maze is a continuous product-discovery platform for unmoderated studies, moderated interviews, participant recruitment, research repositories, reports, and insights.
agentUseSummary: Connect an authorized Enterprise user to Maze's official read-only hosted MCP, then let selected agents search permitted studies and analyze details, results, task metrics, themes, highlights, responses, and transcripts. Relay blocks every mutation and unverified tool.

capabilities.label: Read product research
capabilities.description: Search authorized studies and read study details, results, task metrics, themes, highlights, responses, and transcripts through Maze's official read-only hosted MCP.

allowed.label: Read Maze research
allowed.description: Use one live-discovered, verified non-mutating Maze MCP tool with bounded arguments.

blocked.label: Change Maze
blocked.description: The official Maze MCP is read-only; all mutations and unverified tools remain blocked.

blocked.label: Call an unverified tool
blocked.description: Tools with mutating names or descriptions, destructive annotations, false read-only annotations, invalid schemas, or credential-bearing arguments are blocked.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary endpoints
blocked.description: Requests are pinned to the official Maze MCP and discovered provider schemas; arbitrary REST hosts, paths, and methods are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Live-discovered read-only research tools run directly; mutating names, non-read-only annotations, credentials in arguments, and all writes remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one bounded read wrapper and proxies user OAuth to Maze's official hosted MCP.
Railway mounts one bounded read wrapper and proxies user OAuth to Maze's official hosted MCP.

providerSetup.blocker: Maze MCP is an Enterprise Beta and no authorized customer account, dynamically registered Relay OAuth client, consent grant, live tool schema, or safe research fixture is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: After an Enterprise administrator enables third-party connectors and Relay's dynamic OAuth client is configured, an authorized user connects through Relay Console and verifies refresh, live read-only tool discovery, bounded research retrieval, workspace isolation, disconnect, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Maze documents its Enterprise Beta hosted MCP URL, OAuth 2.1 dynamic discovery, user-scoped workspace permissions, research search and retrieval, transcript and response access, and an explicitly read-only capability boundary.
Maze publishes the protected MCP resource and its current OAuth authorization-server issuer, with Bearer header authentication.

The current Maze authorization issuer publishes dynamic client registration, authorization-code and refresh-token grants, S256 PKCE, public and confidential client authentication, and supported identity scopes.
